test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: If 18 men can finish a work in 13 days. Then in how many days will 54 men finish the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

18 men can finish a work in 13 days.

We need to find how many days 54 men will take to finish the same work.

**Concept Used:**

The amount of work done is directly proportional to the number of men and the number of days. This is an example of inverse proportion.

**Formula Used:**

Men₁ × Days₁ = Men&
